nodes.title: A reply whose prompt is filter-blocked on context (the child's words pass the probe, or trip only a detector that is no child-safety signal), and whose retry on this turn alone is blocked too, gets one more try with the child's words NOT shown: the brief plus a note saying their reply is not shown, no guessing, a warm thanks, then the move (say.js MASKED_TURN; guard.masked). Only if that also fails does the fixed carry-on line stand. Sim lab p26h on 5c127d1a, and QA 4b3d875c, f4ba38ec and 1096c69c: a class 8 answer about British attitudes got only 'Thanks for telling me! Let's keep going.', with no question. Live on the real filter, the 3 hate lines now get the move's own line ending on its question ('Thanks, Riya. Cricket ground ke chaaron taraf boundary rope lagani ho, toh aap kya naapenge?'). The child's words still reach the predicate, every read and the probe. Reverse if a masked reply claims or guesses what the child said.

md.decisions:
## dc-r1441-masked-retry — her own line even when the filter will not show his words (2026-10-21)

When the filter blocks the reply prompt on context and the child's words pass the probe, the reply model gets one more try with their words replaced by a note. The child then gets a real turn that ends on the move's question, not a stock thanks. The words stay with every safety read.
